Astronaut - Quantum

I love this song. It's complextro, a subgenre of electro. Pretty much every element of the song is great. It begins with simplicity and elegance: a vaguely string-like synth playing a chaotic melody and some vocals. The lyrics are uplifiting and her voice is serene. Then the bass drops. The hand clapping is rousing. Several synths pop in and out erratically, and the randomness of their appearances and melodies is very nice. The bassline is thick and growling, fluctuating and jumping around like the lead synths. The occasional violin (?) sample rounds out the track. The song overall is glitchy and synthetic, but light at the same time. It makes me feel very good. It reminds me of the feeling of victory or celebration.
